segments.name: Drug discovery and development
segments.description: A clinical stage biotechnology company developing tRNA synthetase-derived therapies for fibrosis and inflammation, including efzofitimod for interstitial lung disease.
segments.evidence: We view our operations and manage our business in one operating segment, which includes all activities related to the discovery and development of our product candidates.

revenueModel.text: The company earns license and collaboration agreement revenues from partners such as Kyorin, its partner in Japan.
revenueModel.evidence: The Pharmaceutical and Medical Devices Agency (PMDA) has granted efzofitimod orphan drug designation for the treatment of sarcoidosis to Kyorin Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd. (Kyorin), our partner in Japan.
